CONFIRMED but title OVERSTATED. PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue:400-402 varianceRequiresReason() returns true for Math.abs(liveVariance)>0.005 (ANY non-zero ecart); :403-407 varianceReasonMissing blocks submit (template :256 :disabled). Backend CashDrawerService.php:276 only requires reason when abs(variance)>threshold (config/cash.php:31 default 2.00). So a 0.50EUR variance: backend reconciles reason-free, UI demands a >=3 char reason. is_real:true. BUT it does NOT 'block legitimate closes' (title) - it adds a required field = friction, not a hard block (cashier types a reason and proceeds). DOWNGRADE P2->P3: end-of-day friction, not a correctness defect. CAVEAT the finding missed: above threshold the backend ALSO requires manager-approval permission (CashDrawerService.php:277+ actorCanOverrideVariance, CODE_MANAGER_APPROVAL), which the UI does NOT gate - so the recommended fix (sync UI threshold to 2EUR) makes the UI UNDER-strict for the above-threshold manager-approval case. Any threshold-sync fix must also surface the manager-approval gate.

CONFIRMED mechanism, DOWNGRADE P2->P3. CashDrawerService.js:116-136 closeSession() fires POST /{id}/close (:122), awaits, then POST /{id}/reconcile (:130) as a SEPARATE request. If reconcile fails after close, session is STATUS_CLOSED (CashDrawerService.php:183) but not RECONCILED (:325 sets expected_closing_amount/variance). Standalone reconcile() export exists (CashDrawerService.js:148) but grep shows it is NEVER called by store or dialog. Store cashDrawer.js:121-149 clears session only on full success, keeps stale OPEN ref on failure. HOWEVER recovery is NOT broken as the title claims: backend close-when-already-closed (CashDrawerService.php:177-179) returns transitioned:false (no-op, does NOT throw), so re-clicking the dialog's 'Confirmer la cloture' (submitClose->closeSession->/close no-op then /reconcile runs) DOES finish reconciliation. So 'no UI path to finish it' is too strong - the same button recovers. Real robustness gap (relies on user re-click after error toast, store holds stale state) but self-healing -> P3 not P2.

CONFIRMED. CashDrawerService.php:475-482 findOpenSessionForUser filters on branch_id AND opened_by_user_id AND status=OPEN - per-USER scoping is real. PosComponent.vue:2400-2422 autoLoadCashSession -> loadCurrentSession({branchId}); if null -> cashSessionInitialMode='open' + dialog auto-pops (:2410-2413). On a V1 single box, cashiers log in under their own accounts; cashier B taking over A's still-open till is prompted to open a SECOND session, fragmenting the physical drawer's cash across two accounting sessions -> guaranteed variance for both. The finding correctly flags this owner-gated (changes the accounting model) and rates medium confidence. Valid P2 logic/accounting concern; one physical drawer should map to one open session. Severity appropriate - not blind-healed, surfaced to owner.

Observation true but recommended_correction is INFEASIBLE -> DROP. AdminPosV4Controller.php:16-20 docblock states 'NO auth middleware - the Blade is publicly servable'; web.php:53-56 route /admin/pos-v4/{any?} has only ['installed'] middleware; the catch-all web.php:62 RootController@index (also only ['installed']) serves the ENTIRE admin SPA incl. /admin/pos unauthenticated. Cash APIs ARE gated (CashDrawerController.php:22 + CashDrawerSessionController.php:31 permission:pos) = zero data exposure. DECISIVE: the SPA authenticates via Bearer token in localStorage, NOT cookie session - app.js:210 'SPA is Bearer-[based]', bootstrap.js:310 'this SPA uses Bearer tokens', pos-app.js:195 Bearer per axios call, and Kernel.php:52 EnsureFrontendRequestsAreStateful is COMMENTED OUT (Sanctum stateful disabled). A full-page browser GET to the shell route carries NO Authorization header (token only attached by the axios interceptor on XHR), so adding server-side 'auth' middleware would 302 legitimately-authenticated cashiers to /login - it breaks the real flow. The fix 'really must NOT be done' as written. is_necessary:false, DROP. (Defense-in-depth concern is theoretically valid but the proposed correction is not actionable under this auth architecture.)

CONFIRMED. PosComponent.vue:3916-3930 tryManualFlush only toasts when res.synced>0 (success) or res.failed>0 (warning); the {synced:0,failed:0,skipped:false} branch (usePosOfflineState.js:39-63 returns this when queue already drained by 30s auto-flush) produces NO toast. CONFIRMED. PosComponent.vue:2430-2434 onCashSessionOpened(session) has an aspirational comment ('leave dialog open in active view so cashier sees the live stats') but an EMPTY body - the session param is unused and the method does nothing. The actual mode switch to 'active' happens inside the dialog's own submitOpen (PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue:502 this.mode='active'), and the badge updates because the Vuex action mutated the store, NOT because of this handler. Genuinely dead/empty handler - exactly the 'flou' (misleading empty handler) the owner called out, and NOT a NO-OP false-positive like the prior editor_id case (this one IS real dead code, just harmless today). P3 deadcode accurate. Smallest fix: delete the method + @session-opened binding.
